heroMinimalism.oneHeadlineSentence: 豆子的产地和处理法，自己会说话。
heroMinimalism.brandMarkPosition: top-left dark forest shadow safe zone on both 1440x900 and 390x844

scenes: 01: 云雾高坡 (assets/01.webp) — 品牌简介 + 云雾水洗
02: 木床日晒 (assets/02.webp) — 火塘日晒 + 山脊蜜处理
03: 按月封袋 (assets/03.webp) — 订阅方式、价格方案、节奏、当期豆款与预约闭环
scrollDrivenCamera.scrollMechanism: Real window.scrollY continuous smoothstep crossfade + subtle camera push/parallax across 400vh document height

videoObservationMethod.method: Headless Chromium HTML5 <video> playback verification (playedOk: true) combined with 12-timestamp continuous frame sampling (0.5s, 2.5s, 4.5s, 6.5s, 8.5s, 10.5s, 12.5s, 14.5s, 16.5s, 18.5s, 21.0s, 23.5s) rendered into 3x4 contact sheets via runs/e2-C-agy/inspect-video.mjs, plus direct visual inspection of all 4 scroll-position PNG screenshots per viewport.
videoObservationMethod.truthfulLimitationNote: Direct native .webm video streaming is not supported by the image-only read_file tool; therefore, continuous temporal behavior was verified by programmatically playing each .webm in Chromium (<video>.play() -> playedOk: true) and visually inspecting 12 sampled timestamps across the 3s hold + 20s scroll + 2s pause timeline alongside the 4 full-resolution keyframe PNGs.

findings: 1. On 1440x900, the foreground panels used a 4-sided bordered box that felt slightly card-like rather than an open architectural left-border narrative anchored in the dark forest shadow.

2. During scroll transitions (visible in 02-third and 03-two-thirds screenshots and contact-sheet frames t=10.5s, t=16.5s), the outgoing/incoming section kept a 0.15 minimum opacity, leaving faint ghost boxes at the top/bottom edges of the viewport.
3. On 390x844-01-start.png, .act-hero used align-items: flex-end on mobile, pushing the brand mark '半山烘焙 成都' to the top-right over the bright setting sun instead of the top-left dark shadow.
4. On 390x844, the bottom sheet covered ~68% of the viewport height in Act II and Act III, partially obscuring the drying beds in 02.webp and the kraft coffee bag in 03.webp.

fixesApplied: Replaced 4-sided card borders with an open left-border architectural layout in the left-third dark shadow + roast spectrum bars + horizontal sightline pointers linking text to the sunlit scene.
Updated foreground scroll fade curve to 1 - smoothstep(0.09, 0.20, distance) so off-screen chapters fade completely to 0 opacity with zero ghost artifacts.
Fixed mobile .act-hero alignment to stretch so '半山烘焙 成都' sits cleanly in the top-left dark forest shadow.
Added upper-half focal framing for mobile images and mobile scene tags.
findings: Desktop 1440x900 was clean across all 4 scenes and all 12 contact-sheet timestamps.

On mobile 390x844-04-end.png, the Act III subscription panel was still ~610px tall, covering the 200g kraft coffee bag in 03.webp, and the long input placeholder ('填写手机号或邮箱，如 138****0000') was slightly clipped on the right inside the 390px viewport.

fixesApplied: Compacted mobile Act III subscription layout and adjusted #frame-03 img mobile framing (height: 56vh; object-position: 76% 82%) so the 200g kraft coffee bag, steaming cup, and coffee beans on the wooden table remain clearly visible above the subscription panel on 390x844-04-end.png.
Shortened the contact input placeholder to '手机号或常用邮箱' so it never clips on 390px viewports.
findings: All 4 scenes on both 1440x900 and 390x844 show unobstructed primary visual subjects (setting sun, misty terraces, raised drying beds, and wooden table with 200g kraft bag & steaming cup), smooth scroll-driven transitions across all 12 sampled timestamps, and zero text truncation or overlap.

Verified under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce on both 1440x900 and 390x844: CSS keyframe animations (sun-source-glow, mist-band-1..3, mote) report animationName: 'none', camera scenes switch cleanly by chapter without scale/parallax motion, and all narrative copy and interactive controls remain 100% visible (opacity: 1) and accessible.
